name: google_drive.files.export
description: Export a Google Workspace document to a requested MIME type and return bytes.

real_tool_schema.description: Exports a Google Workspace document to the requested MIME type and returns exported byte content. For more information, see [Download and export files](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads). Note that the exported content is limited to 10 MB.

mimeType.description: Required. The MIME type of the format requested for this export. For a list of supported MIME types, see [Export MIME types for Google Workspace documents](/workspace/drive/api/guides/ref-export-formats).

benchmark_projection.note: Benchmark-facing projection of the real tool/API schema used to keep authorization samples readable and comparable.
